changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: BD ANALOG plays Analog BD's 808 and 909 bass drums (the 909 refitted to a recorded TR-909) on the BD, SD and BT tracks, through the voice's own filter, AMP and OVR.
Tap B on the SYNTH page to switch 808 and 909; the type is saved with the sound. Velocity is the accent.
Up to three BD ANALOG voices can hit at the same instant; hits spread across the beat cost less.
Ported from repeat98's Octatrack module, with his permission.
